facts.text: The City of Barrie's 2025 Business & Employer Data Survey identifies 4,389 active businesses in the city.
Barrie has a well-diversified economy in which no single industry accounts for more than 19% of the city's business base or total employment.
Royal Victoria Regional Health Centre employs more than 3,000 people, including 400 physicians, and is a University of Toronto teaching hospital.
Georgian College employs about 2,000 full- and part-time staff, and its Barrie facilities are the largest of its seven campuses.
Royal Victoria Regional Health Centre is undertaking a multi-billion-dollar plan to double the size of its Georgian Drive North Campus over the next 10 years.

overview: Barrie had 147,829 residents in the 2021 Census, up 4.5% from 141,434 in 2016, living in 55,316 occupied private dwellings on 99.01 square kilometres. The median age is 39.2 and the median household income in 2020 was $93,000, so households here have more to spend than in many Ontario cities of similar size.

The business base is broad, with 4,389 active businesses and no single industry above 19% of employment. Local firms compete in a crowded field, but they sell to relatively young, well-paid households.
